title: Building Polymarket Terminal and Data Layer for your agents
author: Left_Skin2857
selftext:
Hey all !!

I've been spending some time on Polymarket and feeling like I'm missing something.  
It's just one line chart.. so it's hard to tell what actually happened inside a 5-min round or right before a big move.

So I'm currently building [Omens](https://omens.market) with my friend(dev guy), basically a trading terminal for Polymarket. Candles (down to 1s), some sort of infos that I wanted to see with chart,,  
And also, we are gonna make flexible charting for multi-view

https://preview.redd.it/juvd7hccwurh1.png?width=3222&format=png&auto=webp&s=5faa66f3b3714f50ea6d50d1867b36f1718fc6c0

it's like early stage of building and it would be good to know about your needs during your prediction market bets guys.

Drop it in the comments, or DM me if you'd rather keep it private. I'll build the most requested stuff first and you'll get to try it before anyone else.

Thanks guys, chill!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the 1s candles are the right call and also the expensive one, storage and the pull rate from the API will bite before the UI does. the thing I'd want in a polymarket terminal that nothing has is the order book at the moment of each resolution, because the last five minutes of a round is where the money changes hands and the line chart hides all of it.

replies.author: Left_Skin2857
replies.body:
Thanks buddy

maybe we can make that orderbook research feature right before the end of rounds

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the last 5 minutes before resolution is the one dataset nobody has kept. even a snapshot every 10 seconds of the top 5 levels would be enough to see the pull-aways.
